fusions.name: Drizzle Spray
fusions.desc: Spits a thin stream that deals 3 damage and has a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloudburst Croak
fusions.desc: A croak that brings down a downpour, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds when it lands.

fusions.name: Soaking Round
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Wet Season
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
